source.extractionPreview:
4
The Enemy
Pearl S. Buck
Before you Read
It is the time of the World War. An American prisoner of war is 
washed ashore in a dying state and is found at the doorstep of a 
Japanese doctor. Should he save him as a doctor or hand him over to 
the Army as a patriot?
Dr Sadao Hoki's house was built on a spot of 
the Japanese coast where as a little boy he had 
often played. The low, square stone house was 
set upon rocks well above a narrow beach that 
was outlined with bent pines. As a boy Sadao
